120Python's Streets of Rage 2 Notes

Assembly
Document Information
AuthorExtraPythons
CategoryAssembly
PlatformSega Genesis
GameStreets of Rage 2
Version1.0
Release Date25 March 2026
Downloads54
Last Modified 25 March 2026

Description:

This document contains a large amount of offsets and information that is extremely useful for modding things in Streets of Rage 2 for SEGA GENESIS, such as the game settings, special moves and throws, physics, damage, music, sounds, etc.

This was done to make things easier for future hacks and hopefully inspire people to get creative and make their own.

This is for vanilla Streets of Rage 2 USA.

Syndicate Wars 0.9 is also fully covered alongside it.
